text:
maria-g: Quick flag on INV-24-0903 — AP spotted a new line called `inference_handling_fee` under Dedicated. Not in our SOW. Can @vendors-billing confirm origin?

vendors-billing: Sorry about that, Maria. It's a new line for cross-region routing we started itemizing in July. We should have given advance notice.

jonah: We didn't sign up for any cross-region routing surcharge on committed capacity. Our contract lists reserved capacity and burst/overage only. Where's the contractual basis?

vendors-billing: It was in the May addendum email thread; however I agree we shouldn't have started billing without reconciling with customers first.

maria-g: AP has put payment on hold until clarified. Here's the invoice snippet they sent: 

```
INV-2024-0903
- dedicated_reserved_commit: $12,000.00
- burst_overage (us-west): $480.00
- inference_handling_fee: $120.00
Total: $12,600.00
```

lia-accounting: I've tagged INV-2024-0903 as ON_HOLD (code: vendor_dispute). AP won't pay until we have vendor confirmation or a credit.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0903 status -> ON_HOLD by lia-accounting at 2024-09-04T14:12:00Z

sam-finance: Can you share the usage window and rule that triggered the inference_handling_fee? We need a reproducible calc to reconcile with our meters.

vendors-billing: Our internal logs show a short spill 2024-08-29T03:10Z to 2024-08-29T06:20Z where ~12% traffic was routed to eu-west fallback. Fee is $40/hr when fallback >10% sustained qps for >1h.

jonah: That routing was during an autoscaler cold-start in us-west. Per our SLA, that should be handled via credits for downtime, not a new surcharge. Committed capacity should not accrue routing fees during provider recovery events.

vendors-billing: Understood. Two proposed remediations: 1) issue a one-time credit for $120 and mark the invoice updated, or 2) leave the line and provide per-request meter CSV for audit.

maria-g: We want option 1 — credit plus updated invoice PDF and a short note explaining the threshold and when this fee will apply in future invoices (procurement needs that).

lia-accounting: Once CM posted we'll clear the ON_HOLD flag and schedule payment.

vendors-billing: Credit created CM-2024-0897 ($120). We'll attach explanatory note and update future cycles to call out this fee + threshold language. Apologies for the lack of notice.

sam-finance: Filed internal ticket FIN-497 to ensure product/contract won't apply this retroactively to other committed accounts.

maria-g: Thanks. @lia-accounting confirm when the credit appears and we'll close the loop. :thumbsup: 

lia-accounting: Tracking CM-2024-0897 now; will update when applied.

vendors-billing: We'll close from our side once the credit shows applied.
